Get video ids
```{r}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

api_key <- Sys.getenv("YOUTUBE_API_KEY")

url <- "https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/search"

res <- GET(
  url,
  query = list(
    part = "snippet",
    q = "double disc court",
    maxResults = 25,
    type = "video",
    key = api_key
  )
)

dat <- fromJSON(content(res, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))

video_ids <- dat$items$id$videoId
```

Get view counts
```{r}
url2 <- "https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/videos"

res2 <- GET(
  url2,
  query = list(
    part = "statistics",
    id = paste(video_ids, collapse = ","),
    key = api_key
  )
)

stats <- fromJSON(content(res2, "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))

views <- as.numeric(stats$items$statistics$viewCount)
sum(views)
```

Do it for all disc activities

```{r}
# ============================================================
# YouTube demand index for frisbee activities
# Requires: YOUTUBE_API_KEY in .Renviron
# ============================================================

# -----------------------------
# 0) Packages
# -----------------------------
pkgs <- c("httr2", "jsonlite", "dplyr", "purrr", "tibble", "readr", "stringr")
to_install <- pkgs[!sapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(to_install) > 0) install.packages(to_install)

library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

# -----------------------------
# 1) Activity aliases
# -----------------------------
activity_aliases <- list(
  "Ultimate" = c("ultimate frisbee"),
  "Beach Ultimate" = c("beach ultimate"),
  "Goaltimate" = c("goaltimate"),
  "Hot Box" = c("hot box frisbee"),
  "World War Free" = c("world war frisbee"),
  "Double Disc Court" = c("double disc court", "ddc frisbee", "escape frisbee"),
  "Guts" = c("guts frisbee"),
  "Flutter Guts" = c("flutter guts frisbee"),
  "DodgeDisc" = c("dodgedisc", "dodgebee"),
  "Battle Royale" = c("battle royale frisbee"),
  "Discflect / KanJam" = c("kanjam", "discflect"),
  "Frisbee Hoops" = c("frisbee hoops"),
  "BeersBee" = c("beersbee", "polish horseshoes frisbee"),
  "Frisbee H-O-R-S-E" = c("frisbee horse"),
  "Accuracy" = c("accuracy frisbee"),
  "Disc Golf" = c("disc golf"),
  "Speed Lid Golf" = c("speed lid golf"),
  "Distance" = c("distance frisbee"),
  "Self-Caught Flight" = c("mta frisbee", "trc frisbee", "throw run catch"),
  "Discathon" = c("discathon frisbee", "discathon disc"),
  "Freestyle" = c("freestyle frisbee"),
  "Canine Disc" = c("disc dog", "canine disc"),
  "Overall" = c("overall flying disc", "overall frisbee")
)

# -----------------------------
# 2) Settings
# -----------------------------
api_key <- Sys.getenv("YOUTUBE_API_KEY")
if (api_key == "") stop("YOUTUBE_API_KEY not found in environment.")

max_results_search <- 25   # per query; search.list max is 50
sleep_sec <- 0.25          # small pause to be polite
region_code <- NULL        # e.g. "US" or leave NULL
published_after <- NULL    # e.g. "2020-01-01T00:00:00Z" or NULL

# -----------------------------
# 3) Helpers
# -----------------------------
build_or_query <- function(terms) {
  paste(unique(terms), collapse = " | ")
}

safe_num <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

youtube_search_videos <- function(query,
                                  api_key,
                                  max_results = 25,
                                  region_code = NULL,
                                  published_after = NULL) {
  req <- request("https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/search") |>
    req_url_query(
      part = "snippet",
      q = query,
      type = "video",
      maxResults = max_results,
      key = api_key
    )

  if (!is.null(region_code)) {
    req <- req |> req_url_query(regionCode = region_code)
  }

  if (!is.null(published_after)) {
    req <- req |> req_url_query(publishedAfter = published_after)
  }

  resp <- req |> req_perform()
  txt <- resp_body_string(resp)
  dat <- jsonlite::fromJSON(txt, simplifyDataFrame = TRUE)

  if (is.null(dat$items) || nrow(dat$items) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      video_id = character(),
      title = character(),
      channel_title = character(),
      published_at = character()
    ))
  }

  tibble(
    video_id = dat$items$id$videoId,
    title = dat$items$snippet$title,
    channel_title = dat$items$snippet$channelTitle,
    published_at = dat$items$snippet$publishedAt
  ) |>
    distinct(video_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

youtube_video_stats <- function(video_ids, api_key) {
  if (length(video_ids) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      video_id = character(),
      view_count = numeric(),
      like_count = numeric(),
      comment_count = numeric()
    ))
  }

  # videos.list accepts comma-separated IDs; 50 is a safe chunk size
  chunks <- split(video_ids, ceiling(seq_along(video_ids) / 50))

  map_dfr(chunks, function(ids) {
    req <- request("https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/videos") |>
      req_url_query(
        part = "statistics",
        id = paste(ids, collapse = ","),
        key = api_key
      )

    resp <- req |> req_perform()
    txt <- resp_body_string(resp)
    dat <- jsonlite::fromJSON(txt, simplifyDataFrame = TRUE)

    if (is.null(dat$items) || nrow(dat$items) == 0) {
      return(tibble(
        video_id = character(),
        view_count = numeric(),
        like_count = numeric(),
        comment_count = numeric()
      ))
    }

    tibble(
      video_id = dat$items$id,
      view_count = safe_num(dat$items$statistics$viewCount),
      like_count = safe_num(dat$items$statistics$likeCount),
      comment_count = safe_num(dat$items$statistics$commentCount)
    )
  })
}

score_youtube_demand <- function(x_rel) {
  case_when(
    is.na(x_rel)   ~ NA_integer_,
    x_rel >= 0.50  ~ 5L,
    x_rel >= 0.10  ~ 4L,
    x_rel >= 0.02  ~ 3L,
    x_rel >= 0.002 ~ 2L,
    x_rel >= 0.0002 ~ 1L,
    TRUE ~ 0L
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# 4) Build one OR query per activity
# -----------------------------
activity_queries <- tibble(
  activity = names(activity_aliases),
  query = map_chr(activity_aliases, build_or_query)
)

print(activity_queries, n = nrow(activity_queries))

# -----------------------------
# 5) Pull YouTube results
# -----------------------------
youtube_results <- map2_dfr(activity_queries$activity, activity_queries$query, function(activity, query) {
  message("Searching YouTube for: ", activity, " -> ", query)

  Sys.sleep(sleep_sec)

  vids <- youtube_search_videos(
    query = query,
    api_key = api_key,
    max_results = max_results_search,
    region_code = region_code,
    published_after = published_after
  )

  stats <- youtube_video_stats(vids$video_id, api_key = api_key)

  joined <- vids |>
    left_join(stats, by = "video_id") |>
    mutate(
      activity = activity,
      query = query
    )

  if (nrow(joined) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      activity = activity,
      query = query,
      video_id = character(),
      title = character(),
      channel_title = character(),
      published_at = character(),
      view_count = numeric(),
      like_count = numeric(),
      comment_count = numeric()
    ))
  }

  joined
})

# -----------------------------
# 6) Summarise to activity level
# -----------------------------
yt_activity <- youtube_results |>
  group_by(activity, query) |>
  summarise(
    n_videos = sum(!is.na(video_id)),
    total_views = sum(view_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_views = median(view_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_views = mean(view_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_views = max(view_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_channels = n_distinct(channel_title[!is.na(channel_title)]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    total_views = ifelse(is.infinite(total_views), NA_real_, total_views),
    median_views = ifelse(is.infinite(median_views), NA_real_, median_views),
    mean_views = ifelse(is.infinite(mean_views), NA_real_, mean_views),
    max_views = ifelse(is.infinite(max_views), NA_real_, max_views)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 7) Relative index anchored to Disc Golf
# -----------------------------
disc_golf_views <- yt_activity |>
  filter(activity == "Disc Golf") |>
  pull(total_views)

if (length(disc_golf_views) != 1 || is.na(disc_golf_views) || disc_golf_views <= 0) {
  stop("Disc Golf anchor did not return a usable total_views value.")
}

yt_activity <- yt_activity |>
  mutate(
    YT_relative = total_views / disc_golf_views,
    YT_log_index = log10(total_views + 1),
    YT_score = score_youtube_demand(YT_relative),
    YT_confidence = case_when(
      is.na(total_views) | n_videos == 0 ~ "Insufficient signal",
      n_videos >= 20 & n_channels >= 10 ~ "High",
      n_videos >= 10 ~ "Medium",
      TRUE ~ "Low"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(YT_relative))

# -----------------------------
# 8) Optional composite visibility
# -----------------------------
yt_activity <- yt_activity |>
  mutate(
    YT_visibility = log10(total_views + 1) +
      0.25 * log10(median_views + 1) +
      0.10 * log10(n_videos + 1)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 9) Save outputs
# -----------------------------
write_csv(youtube_results, "youtube_frisbee_video_level.csv")
write_csv(yt_activity, "youtube_frisbee_activity_index.csv")

print(yt_activity, n = nrow(yt_activity))
```
